info.title: WaveSpeed
info.description: Generate images and videos with WaveSpeed AI (wavespeed.ai). Submit a prompt to a model, then poll the prediction result until it is completed and return the output URL.

post.summary: Submit an image or video generation task to a WaveSpeed AI model. Returns a prediction id immediately; the task runs asynchronously. After calling this, poll WaveSpeedGetResult with the returned data.id until data.status is `completed`, then present data.outputs[0] (the image/video URL) to the user, e.g. as ![image](url).

parameters.name: model_id
parameters.description: The WaveSpeed model id, in `owner/name` format and may contain slashes. Unless the user asks for a specific model, use `bytedance/seedream-v5.0-pro` for images. Other examples: `bytedance/seedance-v1-pro-t2v-720p` (text-to-video), `wavespeed-ai/flux-dev`. The full catalog is at https://wavespeed.ai/models.

prompt.description: Text description of the desired image or video.

200.description: Task accepted. Remember `data.id` and poll WaveSpeedGetResult with it.

get.summary: Get the result of a previously submitted WaveSpeed prediction. If data.status is `created` or `processing`, wait a moment and call this operation again (typically a few seconds for images, longer for videos). When data.status is `completed`, data.outputs[0] contains the generated image/video URL — show it to the user, e.g. as ![image](url). If data.status is `failed`, report data.error.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The prediction id returned by WaveSpeedSubmit (data.id).

bearerAuth.description: WaveSpeed API key from the wavespeed.ai dashboard.

id.description: Prediction id, used to poll the result.

model.description: The model that ran this prediction.

outputs.description: Generated image/video URLs; present when status is `completed`.
